title: Comfortable, Easy Assembly
text: Comfortable, Easy Assembly. This is more expensive than other office chairs that I have owned, but as the old saying goes, you get what you pay for.  This is worth the price.  This was easy to assemble in less than 1/2 hour.  You can do it alone, but does help if you have two people working on it to help hold parts and you hook them together with the included Allen wrench.  The lumbar support is excellent and you can sit for a long time comfortably.  The arms can be raised or lowered and the armrests can tilt outward, inward or straight.  The only thing that I did not find useful was the headrest.  No amount of adjusting (it raises, lowers and tilts) could get it were it helped much.  You have to lean your head back against the headrest and then you can't do anything else, except relax in the chair.  I should have knocked off one star for the nearly useless headrest, but all the other overall features of the chair more than make up for this one deficiency.  This is the first chair that I have owned that had a dedicated headrest, although some high back office chairs do support the head.
